  "title": "HR and Administration Coordinator",
  "description": "Lindii Peace Foundation (LPF) is a Non-Profit and Non-governmental Organization in Nigeria which was registered as a corporate body with the Corporate Affairs Commission on the Eleventh (11th) day of July, 2014.

The foundation was formed by some eminent survivors of the Insurgency in North-east Nigeria and a few well-meaning Individuals who came together with a vision to see Nigeria a poverty free place where peace will abide and humanity can live freely in harmony.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR and Administration Coordinator

Job Location: Maiduguri, Borno

Role Summary


	The Supply Chain Coordinator will provide technical oversight and coordination across procurement, logistics, inventory and warehouse management, fleet operations, asset management, supplier management, and distribution support.
	The role will ensure that supply chain activities are conducted in accordance with organizational policies, donor requirements, internal controls, and applicable regulatory standards.
	The successful candidate will work closely with programme teams, Finance, Administration, field offices, suppliers, and other stakeholders to strengthen supply chain planning, improve operational efficiency, manage risks, and ensure that programme teams receive the goods and services required to deliver quality assistance to affected communities.


Key Responsibilities
Human Resource Planning and Coordination:


	Coordinate the implementation of the organization&#39;s HR strategy, annual work plans, and priorities in alignment with organizational objectives and operational needs.
	Support workforce planning, staffing reviews, organizational restructuring, and the development or revision of job descriptions in collaboration with departmental heads.
	Maintain an updated overview of staffing levels, vacancies, contract timelines, deployment arrangements, and workforce requirements across the organization.
	Advise management on HR priorities, staffing risks, employee relations, organizational development, and people management practices.
	Support the establishment and continuous improvement of HR systems, procedures, tools, and reporting mechanisms.


Recruitment and Selection:


	Coordinate end-to-end recruitment processes, including vacancy announcements, application management, shortlisting, interview scheduling, assessments, reference checks, and documentation of selection decisions.
	Work with hiring managers to ensure that job descriptions, person specifications, and selection criteria accurately reflect approved staffing needs.
	Ensure that recruitment processes are transparent, fair, competitive, merit-based, and consistent with organizational policies and donor requirements.
	Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure that recruitment files contain complete and appropriately authorized documentation.
	Support timely communication with applicants and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
	Promote equal opportunity, diversity, inclusion, and safeguarding considerations in recruitment and selection.


Onboarding, Induction and Separation:


	Coordinate staff onboarding, including employment documentation, contract issuance, orientation, induction, policy acknowledgment, and assignment of responsibilities.
	Ensure that new personnel receive appropriate information on the organization&#39;s structure, policies, Code of Conduct, safeguarding obligations, and performance expectations.
	Coordinate probation monitoring and ensure that supervisors complete probationary assessments within the required timelines.
	Manage employee separation processes, including resignation and contract-end documentation, exit interviews, clearance procedures, and handover arrangements.
	Ensure that staff records are updated promptly following appointments, transfers, promotions, contract amendments, and separations.
	Support structured handovers and knowledge transfer to reduce operational disruption during staff transitions.


Employment Contracts and HR Documentation:


	Prepare, review, issue, and maintain employment contracts, contract amendments, job descriptions, appointment letters, and other HR documentation in accordance with approved procedures.
	Monitor contract expiry dates and notify management and relevant supervisors of upcoming renewals, extensions, or separations in a timely manner.
	Ensure that employment documentation reflects approved terms and conditions and is appropriately authorized before issuance.
	Maintain a secure and organized personnel filing system, including physical and electronic records, with access restricted to authorized personnel.
	Review HR documentation periodically to identify gaps, inconsistencies, expired documents, or areas requiring corrective action.
	Ensure that personnel records are accurate, confidential, retrievable, and managed in accordance with applicable data protection requirements.


HR Policies, Procedures and Compliance:


	Coordinate the implementation, communication, and periodic review of the organization&#39;s HR Manual, employee handbook, Code of Conduct, and other relevant HR policies and procedures.
	Support management in developing or updating HR policies to address operational needs, employment standards, staff welfare, workplace conduct, and organizational effectiveness.
	Ensure that staff and supervisors understand relevant HR policies, procedures, responsibilities, and approval requirements.
	Monitor compliance with organizational HR procedures and applicable Nigerian employment requirements, escalating identified gaps to management.
	Provide guidance on leave administration, attendance, working hours, staff conduct, disciplinary procedures, grievance handling, and other HR matters.
	Maintain an HR compliance tracker and follow up on corrective actions arising from internal reviews, audits, or management decisions.


Employee Relations and Grievance Management:


	Support the consistent and fair management of employee relations matters, including workplace concerns, grievances, interpersonal conflicts, misconduct allegations, and disciplinary issues.
	Advise supervisors and managers on appropriate people management practices, documentation, and adherence to established procedures.
	Coordinate the receipt, documentation, referral, and follow-up of employee grievances in accordance with approved channels and confidentiality requirements.
	Facilitate appropriate resolution processes while maintaining impartiality, procedural fairness, and respect for the rights of all parties.
	Refer safeguarding-related concerns, harassment allegations, and other sensitive cases to the designated authorized channels without conducting unauthorized investigations.
	Monitor recurring employee relations issues and recommend preventive measures to improve workplace culture and reduce organizational risk.


Performance Management and Staff Development:


	Coordinate the organization&#39;s performance management cycle, including objective setting, probation reviews, periodic performance assessments, performance improvement plans, and end-of-contract evaluations.
	Ensure that supervisors understand performance management procedures and complete assessments within established timelines.
	Support managers in documenting performance concerns, providing constructive feedback, and agreeing on appropriate improvement measures.
	Track completion of performance reviews and follow up on outstanding assessments and agreed actions.
	Identify learning and development needs through performance reviews, management consultations, and organizational capacity assessments.
	Coordinate staff training, management development, induction sessions, and other learning activities in line with organizational priorities and available resources.
	Promote a culture of continuous learning, professional accountability, recognition, and performance improvement.


Leave, Attendance and Staff Welfare:


	Coordinate leave administration and ensure that leave requests, approvals, balances, and supporting records are maintained accurately.
	Monitor leave planning and follow up on outstanding leave records to support workforce continuity and compliance with organizational policy.
	Coordinate attendance monitoring and support managers in addressing persistent lateness, absenteeism, and other attendance-related concerns through established procedures.
	Support staff welfare initiatives, workplace well-being, and appropriate communication on employee benefits and entitlements.
	Liaise with Finance on approved HR-related payments, staff entitlements, benefits, and other employment matters requiring financial coordination.
	Ensure that staff welfare concerns are handled professionally, consistently, and in accordance with organizational policies.


Payroll and Benefits Coordination:


	Coordinate with Finance to ensure that approved staff information affecting payroll, allowances, benefits, and other employment-related payments is accurate and submitted within established timelines.
	Communicate authorized changes in staffing status, contract terms, salary adjustments, leave status, and other relevant employee information to Finance.
	Support the verification of personnel records and authorized changes required for payroll processing.
	Coordinate documentation relating to pension, health insurance, statutory contributions, and other applicable employee benefits, in collaboration with Finance and relevant service providers.
	Maintain confidentiality of employee compensation and benefits information.
	Report discrepancies in employment records or staff entitlement calculations to the appropriate responsible department for review and correction.


Organizational Development and Management Support:


	Support organizational development initiatives aimed at strengthening management practices, team effectiveness, accountability, and workplace culture.
	Work with management to identify HR system gaps and recommend practical improvements to organizational structure, reporting relationships, role clarity, and staff coordination.
	Support the development and implementation of staff engagement initiatives, internal communication practices, and change management activities.
	Facilitate management discussions and staff orientations on performance expectations, workplace standards, HR policies, and organizational values.
	Support managers in building their capacity to supervise teams, manage performance, address workplace concerns, and apply HR procedures consistently.
	Contribute to organizational reviews and reform initiatives by providing relevant HR data, analysis, and recommendations.


Administrative Services and Office Management:


	Coordinate general administrative services to ensure the efficient functioning of the head office and support to field locations.
	Oversee office facilities, utilities, office supplies, equipment, maintenance requests, and other administrative requirements.
	Ensure that office assets, equipment, furniture, and other administrative resources are properly recorded, allocated, maintained, and safeguarded.
	Coordinate office access, meeting arrangements, official correspondence, records management, and other administrative support services.
	Monitor administrative service requirements and ensure that requests are handled promptly and in accordance with approved procedures.
	Liaise with the Supply Chain function on procurement, repairs, maintenance, and other administrative requirements requiring specialist support.


Facilities, Accommodation and Service Provider Coordination:


	Coordinate the maintenance and upkeep of office premises, staff accommodation, and other facilities managed by the organization, where applicable.
	Monitor the condition and availability of facilities and ensure that maintenance issues are reported and followed up promptly.
	Support the administration of tenancy documents, service agreements, utility arrangements, and other facility-related records.
	Coordinate with landlords, maintenance providers, cleaners, utility providers, and other service providers in accordance with organizational procedures.
	Ensure that facilities meet reasonable standards of safety, cleanliness, functionality, and suitability for staff and visitors.
	Escalate significant facility-related risks, contract issues, or unplanned expenditure to management.


Records Management and Administrative Controls:


	Establish and maintain organized administrative filing systems for correspondence, office records, service agreements, facility documents, and other relevant records.
	Ensure that administrative records are complete, appropriately authorized, securely stored, and readily accessible to authorized personnel.
	Monitor office supplies and administrative consumables and coordinate replenishment through approved procurement procedures.
	Support the maintenance of administrative trackers, including office assets, service agreements, maintenance schedules, utilities, and other relevant records.
	Ensure that confidential HR and administrative documents are handled in accordance with organizational information management and data protection requirements.
	Identify weaknesses in administrative systems and recommend improvements to documentation, recordkeeping, and internal controls.


Safeguarding, Health, Safety and Workplace Conduct:


	Promote a safe, respectful, inclusive, and professional working environment in line with the organization&#39;s policies and values.
	Ensure that staff receive relevant information on the Code of Conduct, safeguarding, Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA), workplace harassment, discrimination, and reporting channels.
	Coordinate the referral of safeguarding and serious misconduct concerns through established reporting procedures.
	Support the identification and reporting of workplace health, safety, and facilities-related risks.
	Promote compliance with workplace rules, professional standards, and organizational procedures.
	Maintain confidentiality and protect individuals from retaliation or unfair treatment when concerns are raised in good faith.


HR and Administration Reporting:


	Prepare regular HR and administrative reports covering staffing levels, recruitment progress, contract status, leave, performance reviews, training, staff movements, and administrative service delivery.
	Maintain HR dashboards, personnel trackers, contract expiry schedules, recruitment records, and other management information tools.
	Monitor HR and administrative indicators to identify recurring issues, compliance gaps, and areas requiring management attention.
	Provide accurate and timely information to management to support workforce planning, organizational decisions, and operational continuity.
	Ensure that HR and administrative reports are factual, appropriately authorized, and handled in accordance with confidentiality requirements.


Coordination, Team Leadership and Capacity Building:


	Coordinate the work of HR and administrative personnel, where applicable, and ensure that responsibilities are clearly assigned and monitored.
	Provide technical guidance to field teams and supervisors on HR procedures, personnel documentation, and administrative requirements.
	Promote consistent implementation of HR and administrative procedures across the organization&#39;s locations.
	Identify capacity gaps and coordinate relevant training, coaching, and support for staff responsible for HR and administrative tasks.
	Work collaboratively with Finance, Supply Chain, programme teams, MEAL, and management to resolve cross-functional issues.
	Promote professionalism, teamwork, accountability, confidentiality, and continuous improvement within the HR and Administration function.


Other Responsibilities:


	Perform other HR and administration-related duties assigned by the supervisor, provided they are consistent with the purpose of the role, the officer&#39;s competence, and organizational policies.


key Deliverables:


	Updated HR plans, staffing records, organizational charts, and workforce trackers aligned with organizational requirements.
	Timely and properly documented recruitment, onboarding, probation, performance review, and separation processes.
	Accurate and up-to-date employment contracts, job descriptions, personnel files, and contract expiry trackers.
	Improved implementation and monitoring of HR policies, procedures, employee relations processes, and compliance requirements.
	Functional performance management and staff development systems, with completed assessments and tracked follow-up actions.
	Accurate leave, attendance, staff movement, benefits, and payroll-related information submitted to the appropriate departments within agreed timelines.
	Effective coordination of office facilities, administrative services, service agreements, and office resource management.
	Regular HR and administration reports providing reliable information for management decision-making.
	Documented staff orientations, policy communication, management support, and capacity-building activities.
	Practical recommendations and corrective actions to strengthen HR systems, administrative controls, workplace culture, and organizational effectiveness.


Required Qualifications and Experience
Minimum Qualifications:


	A bachelor&#39;s degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, Industrial Relations, Management, or a related field.
	At least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in human resource management, HR administration, organizational development, or a combined HR and administration role.
	Demonstrated experience coordinating recruitment, employment contracts, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, leave administration, and personnel records.
	Practical knowledge of HR policies, employment documentation, staff welfare, workplace conduct, and applicable Nigerian employment requirements.
	Experience coordinating administrative services, office management, facilities, records management, or related support functions.
	Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information and sensitive employee matters with discretion and professionalism.
	Strong writing, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and HR information management tools.
	Ability to work collaboratively with senior management, departmental heads, supervisors, and field teams.
	Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work within established timelines.


Desirable Experience:


	Previous experience working with local or international NGOs, humanitarian organizations, or donor-funded programmes.
	Experience strengthening HR systems, developing HR policies and procedures, improving performance management, or supporting organizational reform.
	Relevant professional certification or membership with the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management of Nigeria (CIPM) or an equivalent recognized HR professional body.
	Experience coordinating HR and administrative services across multiple offices or field locations.
	Familiarity with donor compliance requirements, safeguarding standards, and HR documentation practices in humanitarian settings.
	Experience working in Borno State or other conflict-affected areas of Northeast Nigeria.
	Experience using digital HR systems, personnel databases, recruitment trackers, and performance management tools.


Core Competencies:


	HR Technical Expertise: Demonstrates sound knowledge of HR processes, employment documentation, employee relations, performance management, and policy implementation.
	Planning and Coordination: Organizes HR and administrative activities effectively and manages competing priorities.
	Integrity and Confidentiality: Handles employee information and sensitive workplace matters with discretion, fairness, and professionalism.
	Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Communicates clearly and works effectively with staff, supervisors, and senior management.
	Employee Relations and Conflict Resolution: Addresses workplace concerns objectively and supports fair, consistent, and procedurally appropriate resolution.
	Organizational Development: Identifies opportunities to improve systems, role clarity, management practices, and workplace culture.
	Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate personnel records, contracts, trackers, and administrative documentation.
	Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Uses HR and administrative information to identify risks, resolve issues, and recommend practical improvements.
	Leadership and Teamwork: Provides guidance, supports staff development, and promotes accountability across the organization.
	Adaptability and Resilience: Responds effectively to changing organizational priorities and operational demands.
	Service Orientation: Provides timely, professional, and responsive HR and administrative support to colleagues.
	Commitment to Safeguarding: Upholds safeguarding principles, ethical conduct, non-discrimination, and respect for staff and programme participants.

	Promote consistent implementation of HR and administrative procedures across the organization's locations.
	Identify capacity gaps and coordinate relevant training, coaching, and support for staff responsible for HR and administrative tasks.
	Work collaboratively with Finance, Supply Chain, programme teams, MEAL, and management to resolve cross-functional issues.
	Promote professionalism, teamwork, accountability, confidentiality, and continuous improvement within the HR and Administration function.


Other Responsibilities:


	Perform other HR and administration-related duties assigned by the supervisor, provided they are consistent with the purpose of the role, the officer's competence, and organizational policies.


key Deliverables:


	Updated HR plans, staffing records, organizational charts, and workforce trackers aligned with organizational requirements.
	Timely and properly documented recruitment, onboarding, probation, performance review, and separation processes.
	Accurate and up-to-date employment contracts, job descriptions, personnel files, and contract expiry trackers.
	Improved implementation and monitoring of HR policies, procedures, employee relations processes, and compliance requirements.
	Functional performance management and staff development systems, with completed assessments and tracked follow-up actions.
	Accurate leave, attendance, staff movement, benefits, and payroll-related information submitted to the appropriate departments within agreed timelines.
	Effective coordination of office facilities, administrative services, service agreements, and office resource management.
	Regular HR and administration reports providing reliable information for management decision-making.
	Documented staff orientations, policy communication, management support, and capacity-building activities.
	Practical recommendations and corrective actions to strengthen HR systems, administrative controls, workplace culture, and organizational effectiveness.


Required Qualifications and Experience
Minimum Qualifications:


	A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Public Administration, Industrial Relations, Management, or a related field.
	At least five (5) years of relevant professional experience in human resource management, HR administration, organizational development, or a combined HR and administration role.
	Demonstrated experience coordinating recruitment, employment contracts, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, leave administration, and personnel records.
	Practical knowledge of HR policies, employment documentation, staff welfare, workplace conduct, and applicable Nigerian employment requirements.
	Experience coordinating administrative services, office management, facilities, records management, or related support functions.
	Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information and sensitive employee matters with discretion and professionalism.
	Strong writing, communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
	Good computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, email, and HR information management tools.
	Ability to work collaboratively with senior management, departmental heads, supervisors, and field teams.
	Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver accurate work within established timelines.


Desirable Experience:


	Previous experience working with local or international NGOs, humanitarian organizations, or donor-funded programmes.
	Experience strengthening HR systems, developing HR policies and procedures, improving performance management, or supporting organizational reform.
	Relevant professional certification or membership with the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management of Nigeria (CIPM) or an equivalent recognized HR professional body.
	Experience coordinating HR and administrative services across multiple offices or field locations.
	Familiarity with donor compliance requirements, safeguarding standards, and HR documentation practices in humanitarian settings.
	Experience working in Borno State or other conflict-affected areas of Northeast Nigeria.
	Experience using digital HR systems, personnel databases, recruitment trackers, and performance management tools.


Core Competencies:


	HR Technical Expertise: Demonstrates sound knowledge of HR processes, employment documentation, employee relations, performance management, and policy implementation.
	Planning and Coordination: Organizes HR and administrative activities effectively and manages competing priorities.
	Integrity and Confidentiality: Handles employee information and sensitive workplace matters with discretion, fairness, and professionalism.
	Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Communicates clearly and works effectively with staff, supervisors, and senior management.
	Employee Relations and Conflict Resolution: Addresses workplace concerns objectively and supports fair, consistent, and procedurally appropriate resolution.
	Organizational Development: Identifies opportunities to improve systems, role clarity, management practices, and workplace culture.
	Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate personnel records, contracts, trackers, and administrative documentation.
	Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Uses HR and administrative information to identify risks, resolve issues, and recommend practical improvements.
	Leadership and Teamwork: Provides guidance, supports staff development, and promotes accountability across the organization.
	Adaptability and Resilience: Responds effectively to changing organizational priorities and operational demands.
	Service Orientation: Provides timely, professional, and responsive HR and administrative support to colleagues.
	Commitment to Safeguarding: Upholds safeguarding principles, ethical conduct, non-discrimination, and respect for staff and programme participants.

Job Position: Sales Manager

	The Sales Manager is responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth, leading the sales function, and expanding ZBOM&rsquo;s market presence across residential, commercial, and corporate segments.
	This role combines strategic sales leadership, key account management, and showroom oversight, with a strong focus on building long-term relationships with architects, developers, contractors, and high-value clients.

Sales Leadership &amp; Strategy:


	Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to achieve revenue, growth, and market penetration targets.
	Set, monitor, and report on monthly, quarterly, and annual sales KPIs, including pipeline value, conversion rates, and average deal size.
	Lead, coach, and motivate the sales team to consistently meet or exceed targets.
	Oversee showroom sales operations, ensuring high standards of customer engagement and brand representation.

	Identify and pursue new business opportunities with architects, interior designers, property developers, contractors, and corporate clients.
	Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key accounts and strategic partners.
	Lead negotiations for high-value and complex sales deals, ensuring profitable and sustainable agreements.
	Represent the company at industry events, trade fairs, and networking forums to drive brand visibility and partnerships.


Customer Experience &amp; Sales Execution :


	Personally manage high-value or strategic client engagements, from needs assessment through proposal, closing, and post-sale support.
	Oversee the preparation of compelling sales proposals, quotations, and project timelines.
	Ensure seamless coordination with design, production, and installation teams to deliver projects on time and to specification.
	Champion customer satisfaction, retention, and referral generation.


Sales Operations &amp; Reporting :


	Ensure accurate and up-to-date sales data, forecasts, and pipeline management within the CRM system.
	Analyze sales performance trends and market insights to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.
	Provide regular sales reports and insights to senior management.

	Minimum of 5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Management reporting or a related field.
	Experience selling modular or flat-pack furniture solutions.
	Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, or property developers.
	Familiarity with 3D configuration tools or presentation software.
	Knowledge of Nigeria&rsquo;s real estate and construction market dynamics.
	Strong closing skills and ability to negotiate win-win agreements.
	Empathetic approach to understanding client needs and delivering tailored solutions.
	Quickly learn technical specifications and communicate benefits clearly.

	Establishes long-term client partnerships and referral networks.
	Drives personal performance and thrives in a target-driven environment.
	Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams to ensure end-to-end customer satisfaction.
	Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly.
	Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office suite.
	Ability to travel locally for client visits and industry events.
	Valid driver&rsquo;s license and clean driving record.
	Based in the showroom with a hybrid mix of in-store customer engagement and off-site client visits.
	Fast-paced retail atmosphere with peak periods during weekends and promotional events.
	Occasional participation in trade fairs, industry conferences, and community shows.
	Requires standing for extended periods, product demonstrations, and carrying sample materials (up to 10kg).
	High proficiency with Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and modern collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Asana).
	Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of multi-sector business dynamics (Energy, Real Estate, Hospitality, Retail).
	Excellent research skills with an innate curiosity for current affairs and global markets.


Compensation


	Salary is negotiable and will be based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated competencies.

        ZBOM is a furniture and fittings company. We provide customized design and services for a one-stop home solution. It provides comprehensive home solutions, from kitchens to entire homes, for millions of families worldwide.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales Manager 

Job Location: Area 11, Abuja (FCT)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Sales Manager is responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth, leading the sales function, and expanding ZBOM’s market presence across residential, commercial, and corporate segments.
	This role combines strategic sales leadership, key account management, and showroom oversight, with a strong focus on building long-term relationships with architects, developers, contractors, and high-value clients.
	The role holder will develop and execute sales strategies, manage the sales pipeline, mentor sales team members, and collaborate cross-functionally to ensure an exceptional customer experience from lead generation to project delivery.


Key Responsibilities:
Sales Leadership & Strategy:


	Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to achieve revenue, growth, and market penetration targets.
	Set, monitor, and report on monthly, quarterly, and annual sales KPIs, including pipeline value, conversion rates, and average deal size.
	Lead, coach, and motivate the sales team to consistently meet or exceed targets.
	Oversee showroom sales operations, ensuring high standards of customer engagement and brand representation.


Business Development & Key Accounts :


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities with architects, interior designers, property developers, contractors, and corporate clients.
	Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key accounts and strategic partners.
	Lead negotiations for high-value and complex sales deals, ensuring profitable and sustainable agreements.
	Represent the company at industry events, trade fairs, and networking forums to drive brand visibility and partnerships.


Customer Experience & Sales Execution :


	Personally manage high-value or strategic client engagements, from needs assessment through proposal, closing, and post-sale support.
	Oversee the preparation of compelling sales proposals, quotations, and project timelines.
	Ensure seamless coordination with design, production, and installation teams to deliver projects on time and to specification.
	Champion customer satisfaction, retention, and referral generation.


Sales Operations & Reporting :


	Ensure accurate and up-to-date sales data, forecasts, and pipeline management within the CRM system.
	Analyze sales performance trends and market insights to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.
	Provide regular sales reports and insights to senior management.


Required Skills and Competencies


	Minimum of 5 years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Management reporting or a related field.
	Experience selling modular or flat-pack furniture solutions.
	Existing relationships with architects, interior designers, or property developers.
	Familiarity with 3D configuration tools or presentation software.
	Knowledge of Nigeria’s real estate and construction market dynamics.
	Strong closing skills and ability to negotiate win-win agreements.
	Empathetic approach to understanding client needs and delivering tailored solutions.
	Quickly learn technical specifications and communicate benefits clearly.
	Confident public speaking and ability to conduct compelling demos.
	Establishes long-term client partnerships and referral networks.
	Drives personal performance and thrives in a target-driven environment.
	Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams to ensure end-to-end customer satisfaction.
	Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly.
	Proficiency in using CRM software and Microsoft Office suite.
	Ability to travel locally for client visits and industry events.
	Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
	Based in the showroom with a hybrid mix of in-store customer engagement and off-site client visits.
	Fast-paced retail atmosphere with peak periods during weekends and promotional events.
	Occasional participation in trade fairs, industry conferences, and community shows.
	Requires standing for extended periods, product demonstrations, and carrying sample materials (up to 10kg).
	High proficiency with Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and modern collaboration tools (Slack, ClickUp, Asana).
	Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of multi-sector business dynamics (Energy, Real Estate, Hospitality, Retail).
	Excellent research skills with an innate curiosity for current affairs and global markets.


Compensation


	Salary is negotiable and will be based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated competencies.

Tybitx Services International Limited is duly registered with the Nigerian Corporate Affairs Commission, possesses Department of Petroleum Resources (DPR) permits in the provision of Recruitment services/manpower supply & management and Training/manpower development for the oil and gas industries.

Our aim is to support our clients to focus on their core business by taking on the search for employees that meet their strategic goals and aspirations.

We are  recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Head of Human Resources (HR)

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Available to work Monday - Saturday
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Job Summary


	To lead the organization’s human resources function, strengthen HR processes, drive employee engagement, and develop effective talent management strategies across the business.
	The ideal candidate will have strong leadership capabilities, in-depth knowledge of HR best practices, and the ability to align people strategies with organizational objectives.
	The successful candidate will oversee recruitment, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, organizational development, and compliance while building strong relationships with employees, management, clients, and other key stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement HR strategies, policies, and initiatives aligned with the organization’s business objectives and workforce needs.
	Lead and oversee the full recruitment and talent acquisition process, ensuring the organization attracts, selects, and retains high-quality talent.
	Oversee onboarding, workforce planning, performance management, employee development, succession planning, and employee retention initiatives.
	Build and maintain a positive workplace culture by promoting employee engagement, collaboration, accountability, and professional development.
	Manage employee relations, including addressing grievances, resolving workplace concerns, handling disciplinary matters, and ensuring the fair and consistent application of company policies.
	Review, develop, and continuously improve HR policies, procedures, and organizational structures to enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
	Ensure accurate and timely management of employee records, HR documentation, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, and other HR operations.
	Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, employment regulations, company policies, and organizational standards.
	Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, employees, management, and other key stakeholders.
	Work closely with clients and internal teams to understand workforce requirements, provide appropriate HR solutions, and ensure effective delivery of staffing and people-related services where applicable.
	Provide strategic HR advice and recommendations to senior management on workforce planning, employee performance, organizational development, and people-related matters.
	Prepare and present HR reports, workforce insights, and recommendations to management to support informed business decisions.
	Lead, mentor, and develop the HR team, ensuring effective performance, accountability, and achievement of departmental objectives.
	Identify HR challenges and implement practical solutions that improve employee productivity, engagement, and overall business performance.
	Maintain strict confidentiality when handling employee, client, and organizational information.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Management, Psychology, or a related field.
	Minimum 7 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial or leadership capacity.
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, or an equivalent qualification is an advantage.
	Must have experience managing a workforce of at least 1,000 employees and/or prior experience working in the retail industry.
	Strong knowledge of HR policies, employment practices, labor laws, employee relations, and HR best practices.
	Proven experience managing recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, talent development, and HR operations.
	Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and interpersonal skills.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with the capacity to handle complex employee and organizational matters.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced business environment.
	Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR management systems.
	Ability to handle confidential employee, client, and organizational information with discretion and professionalism.
	Strong business acumen and the ability to partner effectively with senior management to support organizational growth and performance.


Application Closing Date: 12th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Senior Sales Officer

Job Location: Anthony, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary:


	Our client in the automobile industry is looking for someone with an automotive sales background and strong sales experience to drive business growth, identify new opportunities, and build lasting client relationships.
	The ideal candidate should be results-driven, target-oriented, and skilled in negotiation and closing deals.
	The successful candidate will play a key role in expanding the company’s market presence, developing effective sales strategies, managing client engagements, and converting business opportunities into sustainable revenue growth, particularly in the sale of SUVs, pickup trucks, and other automobiles.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue new business opportunities through networking, referrals, market research, and creative marketing strategies.
	Promote and sell SUVs, pickup trucks, commercial vehicles, and other automobiles to individual and corporate clients.
	Understand customer needs and recommend suitable vehicles based on their preferences, requirements, and budgets.
	Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships to encourage repeat business, referrals, and customer loyalty.
	Stay informed about vehicle specifications, pricing, market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to provide accurate recommendations.
	Negotiate prices, prepare sales quotations, and follow up with prospective clients to successfully close deals.
	Collaborate with colleagues to achieve and exceed sales targets and contribute to the company's revenue growth.
	Maintain accurate records of sales activities, client interactions, quotations, and transactions.
	Represent the company at automobile exhibitions, trade fairs, promotional events, and other business networking opportunities to attract potential customers.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Sales, Business Administration, or a related field.
	1–2 years of experience in automobile sales, vehicle marketing, business development, or a related sales field.
	Practical understanding of automobile sales processes, vehicle features, pricing, and market dynamics.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software.
	Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with a proven ability to close sales.
	Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn and grow within the automobile industry.
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
	Ability to drive with a valid driver's licence is required.


Application Closing Date: 12th November, 2026. 

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Senior Executive Sales Manager

Job Location: Anthony, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for someone with a Photovoltaic (PV) background and strong sales experience to drive business growth, identify new opportunities, and build lasting client relationships.
	The ideal candidate should be results-driven, target-oriented, and skilled in negotiation and closing deals.
